context:
The simulations follow the diffusion and irreversible consumption of a reactant in a homogeneous medium represented by a one-dimensional periodic domain. The field u is a nonnegative reactant concentration. There is no imposed flow, reactant supply or feedback from reaction products. Two spatially nonuniform initial concentration profiles have different mean doses. Their concentration fields are observed over time without added measurement noise, with the material and nondimensional scales held fixed.

The task is to infer how concentration evolves through consumption and spatial redistribution. The reaction response and transport parameters are unknown. The resulting law will be used to predict the concentration field for new doses and initial spatial distributions in the same medium, without changing the fitted law or its parameters.

fields.name: u
fields.meaning: physically nonnegative reactant concentration; supplied observations follow the declared noise model

units: fixed nondimensional coordinates and fields, with explicit reference scales if dimensional interpretation is supplied

records.relationship: Separately prescribed preparations of the same fixed material and geometry; not independent random replicates.
